scenicChapters.title: Saint Petersburg Imperial Shore
scenicChapters.narrative: For 34 km this is Saint Petersburg Imperial Shore, a road with a name of its own and a reason for it — expect company on a summer weekend. Early is better than fast.

scenicChapters.title: Krasnoe Selo → The Palace and Park Ensemble of the Villag
scenicChapters.narrative: Water arrives beside the road and stays for 34 km. The line follows the shore because there is nowhere else for it to go. Slow enough to look. The surface follows the shoreline, so the corners arrive where the water decided, not where an engineer did.
